spans.s:
n. (-नं)
1 Spending or passing away time.
2 Abiding staying, being.
3 Rejection, ejection, expelling, expulsion.
4 Allaying, alleviating, (as pain or sickness.)
E.
या to go, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be passed or spent as time.
2 To be allayed or relieved though not cured, (disease or a sick person.)
E.
या to go, causal v., अनीयर् aff.

f. (-प्ता)
Twisted or matted hair.
E.
या to go, in the causal form, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
1 Low, vile, contemptible.
2 To be passed or spent, (as time, &c.)
3 (In medicine,) To be alleviated or relieved though not cured, (disease.)
E.
या to go, causal form, aff. यत्.

n. (-नं)
A litter, a palanquin.
E.
याप्य vile, and यान carriage.
